tasks.title: Aggregate test runner
tasks.intent: The suite has no single entry point, so neither CI nor contributors can run it as a unit; a runner makes the whole suite executable and scriptable.
behavior: Given a tests/ tree containing passing and failing .test.js files, when run-tests.js runs, then it executes every test file and exits non-zero because at least one failed
Given a tests/ tree where all files pass, when run-tests.js runs, then it prints a per-file and total summary and exits 0
acceptance: Runs each test file in a child process and aggregates pass/fail
Exits non-zero if any file fails or errors; exits 0 only when all pass
Prints a per-file result line and a total summary
Unit-tested with temp fixture directories (passing set → 0, failing set → non-zero)

tasks.title: GitHub Actions CI workflow
tasks.intent: Nothing runs the suite on PRs, so regressions merge silently; a workflow gates every PR and push to main on a green suite.
behavior: Given a pull request or a push to main, when CI runs, then it checks out the repo, sets up Node, runs node scripts/run-tests.js, and the check fails if the runner exits non-zero
acceptance: Triggers on pull_request and push to main
Runs node scripts/run-tests.js as the gating step
Contract test asserts the workflow triggers and invokes the runner
